why: The agent said it could not read the source, but it never asked for the content to be pasted as text. Its message to the owner only offered 'Paste the policy text or give me a reachable address/path' as one of four options, so pasting was one choice among several, not a clear request. The other options (draft from S-notes only, wait, mark unknown) invite the owner to decide on a different course instead.
